ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the interior surface, contrasted against a low-intensity black perimeter and central vertical column.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white fields occupy the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and distal tips. A vertical black column bisects the fluke at the median notch. Distinctive vertical dark bands (rake marks) are located on the far left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the central axis, measuring approximately 50-60 degrees with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed across the entire trailing edge. Higher amplitude peaks are located on the interior section of the left lobe and the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending outward toward sharply tapered, low-intensity distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least five isolated, low-intensity circular clusters (black spots) distributed across the white fields; three on the right lobe and two on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Cluster of approximately five parallel, vertically aligned dark linear disruptions located on the far left distal quadrant, interrupting the white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks on the distal left lobe and minor irregular notches along the trailing edge consistent with physical trauma or predation attempts.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical white pigmentation field with sharp, high-contrast boundaries at the trailing edge.
